posts.title: catch up trap
posts.description: I’m never really caught up! I have been trying to “catch up” by making myself do the action when the thought spurs up in my mind (e.g., I thought about my friend… I will message them about how I thought of them today), and I feel happier. Today, I was thinking “oh I haven’t blogged. Let me write something.” and I feel glad to post. Japan is getting cold!

posts.title: being human
posts.description: Being human means you’re in a constant state of flux.

posts.title: It's been a minute
posts.description: Man... It's been a minute since I blogged haha. A new phrase I’m taking is "fairly static", a silly series of words from a friend who messaged me the other day about sending mail:
